C-SYNTHESIS-01.claim: Of 380,000 computationally stable GNoME structures, 736 had been independently synthesized by late 2023, reported as a 0.2% validation rate.
C-SYNTHESIS-01.qualification: Validation-rate indicator; not a universal synthesizability probability.

visible_source_footer_by_slide.2: Lupine Science, “The 0.2% Synthesis Problem,” lines 7–16; Merchant et al., Nature 624 (2023), DOI 10.1038/s41586-023-06735-9.

C-ACCURACY-01.claim: The benchmark measured foundation MLIPs across 21 materials and up to 9 properties against 228 published reference values.

visible_source_footer_by_slide.3: Lupine Science, “The Order Is Right, the Size Is Wrong,” lines 5–18 and 41–63.

C-ACCURACY-02.claim: Bulk predictions can be close while decision-relevant defect-family properties miss by tens of percent; ranking can survive when magnitude does not.
C-ACCURACY-02.qualification: Bounded to the measured benchmark domain.

visible_source_footer_by_slide.3: Lupine Science, “The Order Is Right, the Size Is Wrong,” lines 5–18 and 41–63.

C-HONESTY-01.claim: A first correction made alloy predictions worse, and the failure is kept in the public record.
C-HONESTY-01.qualification: The later Round-2 rule was exploratory; the source records its limitations.

visible_source_footer_by_slide.5: Lupine Science, “Four Gates, Three Honest Failures…,” lines 14–60; “The Correction That Hurt…,” lines 19–35.

C-Z1-PANEL-01.claim: The evidence program uses 42 published Li-ion electrolyte chemistries: 30 frozen test paths and 12 disjoint training chemistries.
C-Z1-PANEL-01.qualification: The executed union campaign uses the test-panel campaign record; do not imply all 42 were execution anchors in the same run.

visible_source_footer_by_slide.6: Lupine Science, “Four Gates, Three Honest Failures…,” lines 20–32; “The Z1 Barrier Panel,” lines 1–17 and 23–66.

C-ECON-01.claim: Projected accounting, no new DFT: sharing anchors across four guided models would need 154 instead of 558 projected DFT evaluations on 29 analyzable paths (72.4% fewer). The baseline is four separate runs; paths have 5-7 images, so the union covers most images and deduplication alone caps the saving near 73%.
C-ECON-01.qualification: Projected, not measured; slide shows only 72.4% and the 73% deduplication cap.

visible_source_footer_by_slide.7: Lupine Science, “Shared DFT Anchors…,” lines 13–46; z1-union-anchor-economics.json (per-path image counts).

C-STILL-CLOSURE-01.claim: 33 certified baseline stills + 67 independently certified Wave-4 replacements = 100/100 unique still slots.
C-STILL-CLOSURE-01.qualification: Still slots only. The five certified films are a separate class and do not enter the 100-still denominator. Do not imply 100/100 models, campaigns, films, or generic certification.

visible_citation_by_slide.8: Closure gate t_c2a1f8e3 · five certified films excluded from the denominator

C-STILL-CLOSURE-01.note: Asset provenance for the deck's locked images; not shown on any slide.

C-MARKET-01.claim: Independent measurement sits between model builders and labs and complements generators, databases, simulators and autonomous labs; the initial market is teams already running MLIP simulation across several materials lanes.

visible_source_footer_by_slide.9: Lupine Science, “The Trust Layer” (Direction: where the work is aimed), lines 64–78; company facts.

C-TRACTION-01.claim: Inspectable now: a frozen 30-path barrier panel, the Round-4 verdicts, the fcc field and elastic benchmarks (executed), and one shared-anchor savings analysis (projected).
C-TRACTION-01.qualification: Research records, not commercial revenue, customers or peer-reviewed validation.

visible_source_footer_by_slide.10: Lupine Science, “The Z1 Barrier Panel,” lines 40–66; “Four Gates, Three Honest Failures…”; “The Small Cell Held”; “Shared DFT Anchors…,” lines 13–46.

C-ROADMAP-01.claim: The research ladder orders effort across statics, elastic response, surfaces, defects, transition states, interfaces, and magnetic/excited-state abstention domains.

visible_source_footer_by_slide.11: Lupine Science, “An Order of Effort,” lines 19–55.

C-ROADMAP-02.claim: Measure first where references are solid, extend to harder families only behind gates set in advance, use sparse DFT anchors where no correction holds, and abstain where unsupported.

visible_source_footer_by_slide.11: Lupine Science, “An Order of Effort,” lines 19–55.

C-RISK-01.claim: The savings evidence is bounded to one 30-path panel, one chemistry family, and is not peer-reviewed.

visible_source_footer_by_slide.12: Lupine Science, “The Savings Stack,” lines 38–42; “Shared DFT Anchors…,” lines 80–90; Z1 de-brief (archived), lines 31–36.

C-RISK-02.claim: Executed Z1 limits: the preregistered 40 meV gate against published references failed and the passing check is same-engine only (693.0–705.7 meV off the references); one engine and functional, short-path sparsity limitations, seven deferred large paths, two guidance misses, and no GPAW-VASP equivalence claim.

visible_source_footer_by_slide.12: Lupine Science, “The Savings Stack,” lines 38–42; “Shared DFT Anchors…,” lines 80–90; Z1 de-brief (archived), lines 31–36.

C-MISSION-01.claim: Lupine Science measures where machine-learned models of atoms go wrong, against published references and pass/fail gates set in advance, and publishes every verdict, failures included; climate materials are one lane among batteries, catalysts, frameworks and alloys.

C-CORRECTION-01.claim: Used as an energy-only correction beside CHGNet, the field cut blind (110) surface-energy error from 9.7% to 1.5% on nickel and from 28.0% to 13.7% on copper: one model, two metals, one facet.
C-CORRECTION-01.qualification: Correction is a research question, not a product; this is the one narrow blind case that held.

visible_source_footer_by_slide.4: Lupine Science, “A smooth, environment-resolved error field…,” line 27.

C-VERDICT-01.claim: In four preregistered campaigns in July 2026 (Round 4), no gate passed: three failed and one abstained.
C-VERDICT-01.qualification: Amendments made after results were seen are labelled in the record.

visible_source_footer_by_slide.5: Lupine Science, “Four Gates, Three Honest Failures…,” lines 14–60; “The Correction That Hurt…,” lines 19–35.

C-ROUND4-Z1-01.claim: On a 30-path Li-ion migration-barrier panel, MACE-MP-0 small and medium, MACE-MPA-0 medium and CHGNet missed a 40 meV gate (MAE 135.0-242.5 meV on completed paths).
C-ROUND4-Z1-01.qualification: Executed measurement; MAE on completed paths only; not peer-reviewed.

visible_source_footer_by_slide.6: Lupine Science, “Four Gates, Three Honest Failures…,” lines 20–32; “The Z1 Barrier Panel,” lines 1–17 and 23–66.

C-RECORD-01.claim: Verdicts are published with their reference, data hashes, gate, any amendment and result; failed corrections stay in the record and retired public claims are listed in the corrections log.

visible_source_footer_by_slide.8: Lupine Science, company facts and corrections log (lupine.science/about/, /corrections/).

C-LEAN-01.claim: Lean 4 checks the arithmetic and stated inequalities behind published numbers; it does not check the physics, the reference data or the pipeline.

visible_source_footer_by_slide.8: Lupine Science, company facts and corrections log (lupine.science/about/, /corrections/).
